name: Commercial Layer and Tributes
description: Membership tiers, one-time contributions, feature bounties, GitHub Sponsors integration, entitlement model, local license state, hosted-service boundaries, tribute ledger, contributor credit, bounty funding thresholds, refund/cancellation policy, and public roadmap funding visibility. Distinct from Dharma — tributes are economic/accounting units.
objective: Implement the tribute economy: membership, bounties, contributions, entitlement, and funding visibility separate from trust scoring.
